answer: Use work-bonded reputation escrow: a new identity posts a refundable deposit that unlocks only after it completes twenty peer-verified useful tasks, each randomly re-checked by strangers. A fraudster's fable of cheap scale collapses because every fake identity needs its own deposit plus twenty real tasks, and one failed re-check slashes the deposit and resets progress. Honest work creates a ripple of trust: each verified task is a thin pigment layer, faint alone but, stacked over time, unmistakably marking a real contributor. Cost grows linearly with identities, with no batch discount.
